== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Dagobah-D-4lomsconcussionrifle-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words. This is a full card image with the printed art, lore and title and the text box set again; there is no “E”, and a small round bronze disc sits at the bottom right, beside the game-text box.

The 2013 slip and the same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
